prompt.zh: 你的工作面試是什麼時候？

responses.en: At an office near the bank.
responses.zh: 在銀行附近的一間辦公室。

prompt.en: Would you like to deposit this cash or send it?
prompt.zh: 這筆現金您要存進去，還是要匯出去？

responses.en: Please put it in my account.

prompt.en: Why did you leave your last job?
prompt.zh: 你為什麼離開上一份工作？

responses.en: I left it on the desk.
My family moved here in August.

prompt.zh: 你的車需要換新的煞車。

prompt.en: How often do you use a computer at home?
Which bus goes to the job center?
prompt.zh: 哪一班公車會到就業服務站？

responses.en: Yes, it goes there every day.
I'm looking for a job, too.
I'm not sure. Let's ask the driver.
responses.zh: 我不太確定，我們問司機吧。

prompt.en: Who is going to meet you on your first day?
prompt.zh: 你上班第一天誰會來接你？

responses.en: My new manager, in the lobby.

prompt.en: Isn't your kitchen sink still leaking?
prompt.zh: 你廚房的水槽不是還在漏水嗎？

responses.en: No, the plumber fixed it this morning.
responses.zh: 沒有了，水電師傅今天早上修好了。

prompt.en: How many books would you like to borrow today?
Would you like to work full time or part time?
prompt.zh: 你比較想要全職還是兼職的工作？

responses.en: I worked there for a long time.

prompt.en: Did you pay a fee to send money home?
prompt.zh: 你匯錢回家有付手續費嗎？

prompt.en: Are you here for the ten o'clock interview?
prompt.zh: 您是來參加十點的面試嗎？

prompt.en: When can you pick up your car?
prompt.zh: 你什麼時候可以來牽車？

responses.en: Yes, I can pick it up.

prompt.en: Where did you learn to use a computer?
prompt.zh: 你是在哪裡學會用電腦的？

responses.en: Yes, I use it every day.

prompt.zh: 你下星期一可以開始上班嗎？

responses.en: Let me check my schedule first.

responses.zh: 我上星期一就開始做了。

prompt.en: Why don't you join the computer workshop?
prompt.zh: 你何不參加電腦研習課？

responses.en: That's a good idea. When is it?

lines.en: Hi. I opened an account here last week, and that was free. Today I want to send five hundred dollars to my family in Taiwan.
lines.zh: 你好。我上星期在這裡開了帳戶，那是免費的。今天我想匯五百塊給我在台灣的家人。

lines.en: Sure. If you send it here at the counter, the fee is fifteen dollars.
lines.zh: 好的。如果您在櫃檯這裡匯，手續費是十五塊。

lines.en: That's quite high. Is there another way?
lines.zh: 這有點貴。有別的方法嗎？

lines.en: You can send it online for five dollars. You just need a password for online banking.
lines.zh: 您可以在網路上匯，只要五塊。您只需要一組網路銀行的密碼。

lines.en: Great. Could you help me get one now?
lines.zh: 太好了。妳現在可以幫我申請一組嗎？

questions.en: Why does he ask about another way?
questions.zh: 他為什麼問有沒有別的方法？
options: His account is not open yet.

questions.en: How much will it cost to send the money online?
questions.zh: 在網路上匯這筆錢要多少錢？

lines.en: Hi. Are there any seats left in the basic computer class?
lines.zh: 你好。基礎電腦班還有位子嗎？

lines.en: The Tuesday night class is full, but we have one on Thursday mornings.
lines.zh: 星期二晚上的班滿了，不過我們星期四早上還有一班。

lines.en: I work in the mornings, Monday to Friday. Is there anything on the weekend?
lines.zh: 我星期一到星期五早上都要上班。週末有課嗎？

lines.en: Yes, there's a Saturday class from ten to twelve. It starts in September.
lines.zh: 有，星期六十點到十二點有一班，九月開課。

lines.en: Great. I'll register for that one.
lines.zh: 太好了。我要報名那一班。

questions.en: Why can't she take the Thursday class?
questions.zh: 她為什麼不能上星期四的課？

questions.en: When will her class meet?
questions.zh: 她要上的課是什麼時候？

lines.en: Good evening, everyone. The library will close in fifteen minutes, at eight o'clock.
lines.zh: 各位晚安。圖書館再十五分鐘、也就是八點就要關門了。

lines.en: If you want to borrow books, please take them to the front desk now.
lines.zh: 要借書的人，請現在拿到服務台。

lines.en: The computer room is already closed, but you can still print next to the elevator until ten to eight.
lines.zh: 電腦室已經關了，不過電梯旁邊還可以列印，到七點五十分為止。

lines.en: Tomorrow is Saturday, so we will open at nine and close at five.
lines.zh: 明天是星期六，所以我們九點開門、五點關門。

lines.en: When you leave, please use the main door. Thank you.
lines.zh: 離開時請走大門。謝謝。

questions.en: Where can people print now?
questions.zh: 現在可以在哪裡列印？

questions.en: What time will the library open tomorrow?
questions.zh: 圖書館明天幾點開門？

lines.en: Hi, I'm here to pick up my car. Is it ready?
lines.zh: 你好，我來牽車。好了嗎？

lines.en: Almost. We fixed the brakes, and that came to a hundred and twenty dollars. But we also found a problem with the front tire.
lines.zh: 快好了。煞車修好了，一共一百二十塊。不過我們也發現前輪有問題。

lines.en: That's too bad. How much is a new tire?
lines.zh: 真糟糕。新輪胎要多少錢？

lines.en: About ninety dollars. Or I can repair this one for thirty.
lines.zh: 大概九十塊。或是我可以把這個修一修，三十塊。

lines.en: Let's just repair it for now. I'll come back at five.
lines.zh: 那先修就好。我五點再回來。

questions.en: Why isn't her car ready yet?
questions.zh: 她的車為什麼還沒好？
options: The mechanic found a problem with a tire.

questions.en: How much will she pay for the tire?
questions.zh: 她的輪胎要付多少錢？

lines.en: I found two jobs that could be good for you. One is an office assistant at a bank, and the other is a sales clerk at a clothes shop.
lines.zh: 我找到兩個可能適合你的工作。一個是銀行的辦公室助理，另一個是服飾店的店員。

lines.en: Which one pays more?
lines.zh: 哪一個薪水比較高？

lines.en: The shop pays a little more, but you'd work every weekend.
lines.zh: 服飾店的薪水高一點，但你每個週末都要上班。

lines.en: I'd prefer to have weekends off. Does the bank job require experience?
lines.zh: 我比較想要週末放假。銀行的工作需要經驗嗎？

lines.en: Yes, one year in an office. You worked in an office in Taiwan, so that's fine.
lines.zh: 要，一年的辦公室經驗。你在台灣做過辦公室的工作，所以沒問題。

lines.en: Great. Then I'll apply for that one.
lines.zh: 太好了。那我就應徵那一個。

questions.en: What does the counselor say about the job at the shop?
questions.zh: 輔導員說服飾店的工作怎麼樣？

questions.en: Which job will he apply for?
questions.zh: 他會應徵哪個工作？

lines.en: Excuse me. The ATM outside took my card, and it didn't give it back.
lines.zh: 不好意思。外面的提款機把我的卡吃掉了，沒有退出來。

lines.en: I'm sorry about that. Did you get your cash?
lines.zh: 很抱歉。您有領到現金嗎？

lines.en: No. I asked for eighty dollars, but nothing came out. I need it to pay my rent today.
lines.zh: 沒有。我要領八十塊，但什麼都沒出來。我今天要用它付房租。

lines.en: Let me check your account. OK, the eighty dollars is still there, and there's no fee for this.
lines.zh: 我查一下您的帳戶。好的，那八十塊還在帳戶裡，而且這不會收手續費。

lines.en: That's good. What about my card?
lines.zh: 那就好。那我的卡呢？

lines.en: We'll have it back in about ten minutes. Please take a seat by the window.
lines.zh: 大概十分鐘就能拿回來。請在窗邊坐一下。

questions.en: What problem does he have?
questions.zh: 他遇到什麼問題？
options: The ATM took eighty dollars from his account.
He had to pay a fee.
He can't pay his rent online.

questions.en: What does she ask him to do?
questions.zh: 她請他做什麼？

lines.en: Excuse me. I missed class last Wednesday. Was there any homework?
lines.zh: 不好意思。我上星期三沒來上課。有功課嗎？

lines.en: Yes. Please do the typing exercise on page twelve.
lines.zh: 有。請做第十二頁的打字練習。

lines.en: Page twelve. Do I need to finish it by Monday?
lines.zh: 第十二頁。我要在星期一前做完嗎？

lines.en: No, by next Wednesday, before class. And there's a short test the week after that.
lines.zh: 不用，下星期三上課前做完就好。再下一個星期還有一個小考。

lines.en: OK. Thanks. I'll start it this evening.
lines.zh: 好。謝謝。我今天晚上就開始做。

questions.en: Why does she talk to the teacher?
questions.zh: 她為什麼來找老師說話？
options: She wasn't in class last week.
She wants to take a test.
She wants to change her class to Monday.

questions.en: When does she have to finish the homework?
questions.zh: 她要在什麼時候前做完功課？

lines.en: Hi. I'd like to renew these three books.
lines.zh: 你好。我想續借這三本書。

lines.en: Let me see. You can renew two of them, but someone else is waiting for this one.
lines.zh: 我看看。其中兩本可以續借，但這一本有別人在等。

lines.en: But I haven't finished it yet.
lines.zh: 可是我還沒看完。

lines.en: Sorry, it's due today. But I can put your name on the list, and you can borrow it again later.
lines.zh: 抱歉，這本今天到期。不過我可以把你的名字登記在預約名單上，之後你可以再借。

lines.en: OK, please do that. When are the other two due?
lines.zh: 好，麻煩妳。另外兩本什麼時候到期？

lines.en: On May twentieth.
lines.zh: 五月二十日。

questions.en: Why can't he renew one of the books?
questions.zh: 他為什麼有一本書不能續借？

questions.en: What will the librarian do for him?
questions.zh: 圖書館員會幫他做什麼？
options: Put his name on a list
Keep the book for him until May 20
Show him the other two books

lines.en: Hi, this is Tom. I got your message about the leak under the kitchen sink.
lines.zh: 你好，我是 Tom。我收到你說廚房水槽下面漏水的留言了。

lines.en: I called a plumber, and he can come on Thursday at two in the afternoon.
lines.zh: 我打給水電師傅了，他星期四下午兩點可以過去。

lines.en: If you can't be home then, please call me before Wednesday night. I'll let him in with my key.
lines.zh: 如果你那時不在家，請在星期三晚上之前打給我，我會用我的鑰匙讓他進去。

lines.en: Also, please take everything out of the cabinet under the sink before he arrives.
lines.zh: 還有，請在他到之前把水槽下面櫃子裡的東西都拿出來。

lines.en: Thanks, and sorry for the trouble.
lines.zh: 謝謝，不好意思給你添麻煩了。

questions.en: When will the plumber come?
questions.zh: 水電師傅什麼時候會來？

questions.en: What does Tom ask the person to do?
questions.zh: Tom 請對方做什麼？
options: Clear out the cabinet under the sink

lines.en: Hi, this is Linda Moore from Blue Hill Company. We'd like to offer you the assistant position.
lines.zh: 你好，我是藍丘公司的 Linda Moore。我們想錄取你擔任助理一職。

lines.en: That's great news! Thank you so much. When would you like me to start?
lines.zh: 真是好消息！非常謝謝您。您希望我什麼時候開始上班？

lines.en: Next Monday. Please come at eight thirty and wait in the lobby. I'll meet you there.
lines.zh: 下星期一。請八點半到，在大廳等，我會去那裡接你。

lines.en: Sure. Do I need to wear a suit?
lines.zh: 好的。我需要穿西裝嗎？

lines.en: No, our office is casual. Just bring your ID and your bank information.
lines.zh: 不用，我們辦公室穿得很輕鬆。只要帶你的身分證和銀行帳戶資料就好。

questions.en: Why is Ms. Moore calling?
questions.zh: Moore 女士為什麼打這通電話？
options: To ask him to come to an interview
To tell him he got the job

questions.en: What does Ms. Moore say about the office?
questions.zh: Moore 女士說辦公室怎麼樣？
options: People don't need to wear suits.
It is next to a bank.
